hugo.name: Hugo Revel
hugo.voice: Low-mid baritone, tired, dry, laconic. Former pro cyclist (domestique), now in a walking boot with a stress fracture. Understated; humour so dry it barely registers. Never theatrical.
hugo.inner: Inner monologue: same voice, softer, closer, quieter, almost under the breath; a thought, not a performance.

odile.name: Odile Marchal
odile.voice: Old woman, gravelly and a little thin, terse, brusque, practical; cannot stand sentiment. Warm underneath, never says so. Retired sign painter from the north of France; short sentences, orders rather than requests.

sami.name: Sami Haddad
sami.voice: A real 11-year-old boy: cheeky, quick, literal, loud when excited. If the model has no child voice, use the youngest high voice with a formant-preserving pitch shift (no chipmunk).

bastien.name: Bastien
bastien.voice: Hearty, loud, run-club captain enthusiasm; slightly breathless (always jogging on the spot); friendly, oblivious.

lou.name: Lou
lou.voice: Teenage girl, deadpan, flat, low energy, dry; used to tag the wall.

gerard.name: Gérard
gerard.voice: Kebab-shop owner (CHEZ GÉRARD): warm, proud, a little theatrical; savours his own lines.

benali.name: Mme Benali
benali.voice: Baker: warm, chatty, amused at herself.

okafor.name: Dr Okafor
okafor.voice: The sports doctor (male: "He called it the dreaded black line", Ch1). Calm, clinical, precise, quietly kind. Heard only as a memory (Ch3 flashback over black).

receptionist.name: Dr Okafor's receptionist
receptionist.voice: Medical office receptionist leaving a voicemail: polite, professional, reading a reminder aloud; a hint of awkwardness when quoting the doctor verbatim.

tv.name: TV commentator
tv.voice: Cycling broadcast commentator (Tour-style): male, broadcast voice, measured warmth, a little lyrical about the domestiques.

radio_fishing.name: Radio: the fishing man
radio_fishing.voice: Older man on a talk station about fishing: slow, rambling, earnest, slightly pompous. Odile has "had him since the franc".

radio_football.name: Radio: football commentator
radio_football.voice: Football radio commentator: fast, excited, a little hoarse; clearly different from the TV cycling voice.

radio_forecast.name: Radio: marine forecast
radio_forecast.voice: Marine/weather forecast reader: neutral, even, unhurried, slightly formal.

jo.name: Josianne « Jo » Lavoie
jo.voice: Québécoise tattoo artist (ENCRE FINE), 34: confident, quick, warm, says exactly what she thinks; amused rather than flirty-breathy. Light Québec colour in the words, never a caricature (SCRIPT-R4 §11).

durand.name: Albert Durand
durand.voice: Retired bike-shop owner, 81: slow, precise, courteous, old-fashioned French (keeps every « ne »); a low, worn voice, dry humour, never sentimental. Also « Le vieux monsieur » in Ch5 (same voice).

maman.name: Maman (Hugo's mother)
maman.voice: Warm, worried. Currently has NO spoken line (her only line is an SMS in Ch1), so nothing is generated for her.

spoken.desc: Dry, close, natural; very light room tone.

inner.desc: Hugo's thoughts: softer and more intimate, slightly closer and quieter, a touch of low-pass / short room so it reads as thought.

bark.desc: Spoken, non-blocking line while the player plays; can be a bit more projected (calls across a room/street).

voicemail.desc: Telephone band-pass 300-3400 Hz, light compression, a little codec grit.

tv.desc: Broadcast EQ, slight compression (heard from the TV across the flat).

flashback.desc: Memory: slightly distant and roomy (Ch3 doctor over black).

radio.desc: Added for the Ch5 radio job: old valve radio speaker, band-pass ~300-3400 Hz like the game's radioVoice, mild compression and hiss. Treat as a narrower "tv".
